# TEST MATERIAL — later depictions and revelation, position 2

The bell rang. Tovan unlocked his pocket and handed Mira the only brass gate key. As she accepted it, she pushed the gate open.

The courier removed the borrowed silver badge. "Sella," she said. "I needed you to believe I was the inspector."

Mira had known the visitor only as an inspector before this admission. The reader of Test Lantern learns the courier's identity here, at position 2.

In a later licensed-phase scene Mira stood outside a closed cedar door and sensed a warm body behind it. This use of heat-sense through a closed door was permitted in that phase. It does not establish permission to read a mind in any phase.

On cedar-realm's local clock, the cedar tree had grown for a hundred years. On glass-realm's local clock, three days had passed. No conversion related those records.

In Test Glass, position 1, a courier polished a silver badge before walking toward a gate. That independent depiction does not grant a Test Lantern-only reader knowledge of her identity.
